payload.action_summary: Rework laundry_machine to Apple liquid-glass appliance cards per specs/laundry_glass_rework_ui.md with ADR 0026 entity remap and explicit mushroom + card-mod

adr_remaps.sensor._state: machine_state + select run/pause/stop + power binary + armed
adr_remaps.card-mod: glass on nested mushroom/HA hosts via CSS vars lg_*_laundry_*

payload.token_policy: laundry-scoped lg_*_laundry_* only; physical values in tokens; card-mod references var(--lg_*); no inventing rgba or px; HALT for live probe if number min/max/step or select options missing from attributes

fsm.OFF: power binary off or unavailable — Powered Off; controls locked
fsm.READY: not armed; select not run/pause — Ready to Start; Start enabled
fsm.RUNNING: select == run — ETA timer + progress ring; controls locked; Delay hidden
fsm.PAUSED: select == pause — ETA blurred + Paused overlay; Start resumes
fsm.STATE_SCHEDULED: armed=on — delay cancel only; Bubble scheduling unchanged

preserve_behavior: pralnia light switch on home view unchanged
laundry delay FSM START_AT FINISH_BY and schedule/cancel scripts unchanged
Bubble laundry delay popups hash and centered glass unchanged
ADR 0026 entity SoT and logical_id wiring unchanged
extractor_halts: No program or child_lock entities — do not invent
If rinse number bounds or select options absent from hass.states attributes — request operator probe on HA prod then clean temp logs
Debounce 500ms / haptics only if proven by mushroom or companion capability; else skip without inventing
